name: Cauliflower Fritters with Tzatziki, Smoked Salmon, Greens & Pine Nuts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower and cook, stirring often, until lightly golden and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (340 g) bags frozen, riced cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Transfer cooked cauliflower rice to a large bowl. Add eggs, flour, and spices, then stir to combine the fritter mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
1 ½ cup all-purpose flour
¾ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, scoop the cauliflower mixture into the skillet, spacing each scoop a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a large paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed). Place in a large bowl along with pine nuts and vinaigrette. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
⅓ cup pine nuts
½ cup balsamic vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide salad and fritters between plates; top fritters with tzatziki and salmon. Enjoy!
